summary: Standards: the CLI test gate_tombstone_corpus_02_a_corpus_that_is_not_read_still_judges_the_evidence does not build its Given ('no scenario is read and no tombstone with it'). After `scenario: local` -> `scenario: hot` and deleting the feature file without a sync, .canon/ledger/kind=scenario/ still holds the live gone.leaf.01 record (probed), so the gate sees a declared scenario and judges it; the test would pass with the old 0.39 guard removed or inverted. The real empty-corpus-and-empty-tombstone-set guard is proven only by the unit test staleness::tests::gate_tombstone_corpus_02_..., which does fail if the `!ctx.scenarios.is_empty()` clause is dropped, so the scenario as a whole is covered; the real-binary equivalent (a clone with no index and no feature file) I probed and it is judged stale-evidence as in 0.39. Blast radius: none in code; the CLI half of this scenario's evidence is a weaker proxy than its name says.
